title: Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #77 August 1985 Comic Book ISSN 0712-7774 - Dave Sim
descriptionText: The Aardvark-Vanaheim Cerebus #77 August 1985 Comic Book, featuring the character Cerebus the Aardvark, is a vintage collectible from the US Comics tradition. Written and illustrated by Dave Sim, this single issue from the Cerebus series is a first printing from the Copper Age era. With its unique storyline and character development, this comic book is a must-have for fans of the Cerebus universe and lovers of comic book collecting.
